name: Craftsman's Writ: Wildvine Potion
summary: A transferable writ requests one Wildvine Potion and gives delivery and payment details. You need the writ to complete the transaction.

sections.title: A Written Request
sections.body: The faded note asks you to obtain a Wildvine Potion for its customer. It also gives a delivery location and payment details. The writ can pass from one bearer to another, but you need it with you to complete the transaction.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The customer requests one Wildvine Potion.
The writ provides delivery directions through a location marked on your map.
The writ includes information about payment.

faq.q: Can I give the writ to someone else?
Do I need the writ with me?
faq.answer: Yes. You need to have the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.
